fusions.name: Interrupting Phrase
fusions.desc: Throws a rune-cut knife up to 7 tiles that deals 12 damage, up to 1.3 times harder at maximum range, and stuns the target for 1 second.

fusions.name: Recited Edges
fusions.desc: Speaks a cone of cutting words 4 tiles ahead, dealing 26 damage to everything in it and ignoring resistances.

fusions.name: Etched Fluency
fusions.desc: Increases your casting speed by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Rehearsed Draws
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner.
